note: Node's machine tool on the patched tree: arguments as handed to executeBuiltinTool('machine', args, cwd) and the normalised text it returned (see the manifest's exclusions).

normalisation.cpu: `cpu: N% busy of M cores (250 ms sample)` → `cpu: <n>% busy of <n> cores (250 ms sample)`
normalisation.memory: `memory: A GB available of T GB (P% used)` → `memory: <gb> GB available of <gb> GB (<n>% used)`
normalisation.processRow: `  NAME (pid P)  cpu C%  mem M MB` → `  <process> (pid <n>)  cpu <n>%  mem <n> MB`
normalisation.driveRows: `  ROOT  F GB of T GB` rows (any number) → one `  <drive> <gb> GB of <gb> GB`
normalisation.matchRows: the process rows under `processes matching "X" (N):` (any number up to 25, then `  … K more`) → one `  <process rows>`; N → `<n>` unless 0
normalisation.unavailable: a section Node reports as `unavailable (no answer within the deadline)` is a failed sample, not a shape: the recorder refuses to record one
